subject: ALGEBRA 1
pageTitle: Systems of Equations: Substitution vs Elimination
description: Solve a system of two linear equations by substitution or elimination, and learn which method to choose, with two worked examples.
caption: Systems of equations in 7 swipes: substitution vs elimination and two worked examples. Save this for your algebra test. Free Algebra I study guide at precisstudy.com/algebra1 (no sign-up).

slides.title: PICK YOUR METHOD
lines: Elimination: both equations in the form Ax + By = C
slides.note: Either method gives the same answer.

slides.title: THE STEPS
lines: Get one variable by itself, or line up like terms
Combine or substitute to remove one variable
Solve, then plug back in and check

slides.title: EXAMPLE 1: ELIMINATION
steps: Add the equations: the y terms cancel

slides.title: WATCH OUT
slides.wrong: Subtracting a negative term without changing the sign
points: When you subtract an equation, change every sign in it.
If no variable cancels, multiply one equation first.
A false statement like 0 = 5 means no solution.
